result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: duplicated restaurant cards in Fastest near you and inconsistent favorite-button styling in Popular right now.

issues.description: The first two cards in 'Fastest near you' are identical duplicates showing 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, same '15-25 min' time and same '€0.90 delivery' fee.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry or ensure each carousel card loads distinct restaurant data.

issues.description: Favorite heart button styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': the heart on Tokumaru Ramen Bar has no background scrim while the heart on the pizza card below has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent background scrim to all favorite icons so they remain visible and uniform across cards.
